timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: What's the difference between B2B and B2C? The names confuse me.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: B2B is for partners and collaborators. B2C is for your end customers. Different audiences, different needs.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: So B2B just creates guest accounts in my tenant?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Exactly. Guests authenticate with their own credentials. You control what they access in your environment.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: What about Direct Connect? How's that different from regular B2B?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Direct Connect is bidirectional. Both orgs trust each other's users without creating guest accounts.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: And B2C is for customers who aren't in any enterprise directory?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Right. B2C provides social logins, custom sign-up flows, and identity management for your customers.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Can I use Conditional Access on B2B guests?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Absolutely. Cross-tenant access settings and CA policies apply to guests just like internal users.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: It automatically provisions users from one tenant to another. No manual invites for ongoing collaboration.
